metadata.provenance: Synthesized from public cloud security knowledge

description: S3 bucket misconfiguration exposing sensitive data publicly.

methodology.recon: Check for S3 bucket references in JS, config, etc. (read-only)
testing: Check if bucket listable: curl https://bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/ — should be 403, if 200 with file list then exposed
Check for exposed .env, config, backup in S3 (read-only, within scope)
methodology.evidence: curl output showing bucket listing or file content, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with curl, confirm public access, check if sensitive data

remediation: Private ACL, block public access, encryption, logging
safety: Read-only, within scope, no data deletion, redact sensitive
